To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) the seeing power spectrum is a function of the solar elevation, (ii) it has a minimum at 0.01 Hz for all solar elevations and (iii) it has a power law dependence with the solar elevation at frequencies higher than 0.1 Hz.
the power spectrum of solar seeing is characterized by the presence of a peak in the range 10-30 min, with an amplitude of 0.1-0.3 arc sec, and a FWHM of about 1 arc sec.
the power spectrum of atmospheric seeing in the solar direction is characterized by a peak around 0.01 Hz and a slope of -1.8 for frequencies higher than 0.01Hz.
